required_conditions: compression opportunity exists on the frozen common frame
observed within-coarse conditional AUC exceeds the within-coarse permutation mean
one-sided permutation p <= 0.05 under 9999 frozen permutations
primary_gate.consequence: EL v0.7 becomes SCIENCE_ELIGIBLE_FOR_PROMOTION subject only to normal format/reference/submission checks; v0.3 remains fallback until promotion completes.

fail_gate.consequence: Do not promote v0.7 as a cross-representation hierarchical-memory generalization. Keep v0.3 as current submission. Any revised hierarchical manuscript must explicitly incorporate the failed held-out test.

structural_gate.consequence: Treat as uninformative for the biological generalization. Do not count as PASS or FAIL and do not promote v0.7 on this basis; keep v0.3 current.

hold_gate.consequence: No biological decision. v0.7 remains a non-current candidate and v0.3 remains current.

independence_rule.rule: The global fine-minus-coarse tilt test and the within-coarse hidden-memory test are distinct. One cannot rescue failure of the other after outcome opening.

prohibited_after_outcome: switching to global tilt if hidden-memory fails
switching to hidden-memory if the pre-frozen hidden-memory opportunity gate is not satisfied
changing the tree or common frame because the prospective result is unfavorable
calling a source/common-frame HOLD a biological success
promoting v0.7 after a prospective FAIL without a new explicitly revised candidate version
